```text
Subject: Adjustment Regarding Malfunctioning Mobile Set

Dear Mr. Sharma,

We acknowledge receipt of your complaint letter dated 10th October 2023 regarding the Zenith X1 mobile phone purchased from our store vide Invoice No. GE-4122.

We sincerely regret the inconvenience caused by the unexpected heating and battery-drain issues in your device. After reviewing your warranty card and inspecting the set at our service center, we confirm that the defect is covered under our standard one-year replacement warranty.

We have dispatched a brand-new replacement unit to your address via reliable courier, which will reach you within 2 working days. No additional charges will be levied. 

We value your patronage and assure you of our best services at all times.

Sincerely,

[Signature]
Amit Verma
Customer Relations Manager
Global Electronics Ltd.
```
proTip: An adjustment letter must always remain polite, acknowledge the customer's grievance, offer a clear solution, and rebuild goodwill.
